A good, well cooked, quality ribeye steak from a steer is great. Slow cooked pork ribs can be fantastic, and a good ham or slow-cooked smoked shoulder are awesome. Chicken cordon bleu is fantastic when it's done well. A properly brined turkey is exquisite. Bison is good if you mix in some not-too-lean beef, venison jerky is damn nice, and moose isn't bad, either.

All in all, it depends on what you're in the mood for, what's fresh, what you're capable of preparing, and what sides you have.
